description: Hydropower Generation and Weather-Based Energy Dataset from Karnaphuli Power Station is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Al Shahriar Hossain (Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology). This dataset is a processed and integrated dataset constructed using publicly available power generation data from the Bangladesh Power Development Board (BPDB) and satellite-based meteorological data from NASA IMERG. Coverage: national (BD); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
